original.text: bde ba'i de nyid dang ni bral gyur zhing / / lus kyi dka' thub 'ba' zhig tsam ldan pas/ / dge tshul dge slong gnas brtan zhes bya bas/ / ban+de rnams ni de ltar rab byung nas/ / kha cig mdo sde 'chad par byed cing 'jug / la la ro gcig sems kyi tshul 'dzin mthong / / kha cig theg chen de la rgyug byed cing / / de ni gzhung lugs tshad ma'i bstan bcos yin/ / gzhan yang dkyil 'khor 'khor lo ma lus bsgom/ / kha cig bzhi pa'i don 'chad pa la zhugs/ / la la nam mkha'i khams la rtog par snang / / gzhan yang stong nyid ldan par byed pa de/ / phal cher mi mthun phyogs la zhugs pa yin/ /

paraphrase: Novices, monks and elders who have gone forth possess only bodily austerity and lack the reality of bliss; some expound sūtras, some hold to the mind of one taste, some rush to the Great Vehicle — which is treatise and logic — some meditate on maṇḍala circles, some explain the fourth, some examine the sky element, some cultivate emptiness: most have entered the opposing side.
translation_basis: Tibetan translation (the Apabhraṃśa/Sanskrit original not consulted); paraphrase made by the unit from the Tibetan

original.text: yi ge 'gro ba ma lus pa/ / yi ge med pa gcig kyang med/ / ji srid yi ge med gyur pa/ / de srid yi ge rab tu shes/ /
original.edition: Derge Tengyur/Kangyur, Tōhoku D2224, digital edition by Esukhia and Barom Theksum Choling (github.com/Esukhia/derge-tengyur), file 051_རྒྱུད་འགྲེལ།_ཝི.txt — Tibetan translation, Wylie by the preparer

paraphrase: All beings are letters, not one is without the letter; as long as it is letterless, so long is the letter truly known.
translation_basis: Tibetan translation (the Apabhraṃśa/Sanskrit original not consulted); paraphrase made by the unit from the Tibetan
notes: The paradox is left as the Tibetan states it.

original.text: ji ltar phyi rol de bzhin nang / / bcu bzhi pa yi sa la rgyun du gnas/ / lus med lus la sbas pa ste/ / de shes de yis grol bar 'gyur/ /
original.edition: Derge Tengyur/Kangyur, Tōhoku D2224, digital edition by Esukhia and Barom Theksum Choling (github.com/Esukhia/derge-tengyur), file 051_རྒྱུད་འགྲེལ།_ཝི.txt — Tibetan translation, Wylie by the preparer
original.licence: Public domain (Derge xylograph; Esukhia/Barom digital edition, per the repository)

paraphrase: As outside, so inside; one abides continuously on the fourteenth ground; the bodiless is hidden in the body; whoever knows it is liberated.
translation_basis: Tibetan translation (the Apabhraṃśa/Sanskrit original not consulted); paraphrase made by the unit from the Tibetan

original.text: grogs dag zab pa dang ni rgya che ba/ / gzhan med bdag nyid ma yin no/ / lhan cig skyes dga' bzhi pa'i dus/ / gnyug ma nyams su myong bar shes/ /
original.edition: Derge Tengyur/Kangyur, Tōhoku D2224, digital edition by Esukhia and Barom Theksum Choling (github.com/Esukhia/derge-tengyur), file 051_རྒྱུད་འགྲེལ།_ཝི.txt — Tibetan translation, Wylie by the preparer
original.licence: Public domain (Derge xylograph; Esukhia/Barom digital edition, per the repository)

paraphrase: Friends, the profound and the vast are not other, not self; at the time of the fourth joy, the innate, the natural state is known in experience.
translation_basis: Tibetan translation (the Apabhraṃśa/Sanskrit original not consulted); paraphrase made by the unit from the Tibetan

original.text: gang zhig 'khor ba de ni mya ngan 'das par nges/ / dbye ba gzhan du sems pa ma yin te/ / rang bzhin gcig gis dbye ba rnam par spangs/ / dri ma med pa nga yis rab tu rtogs/ /
original.edition: Derge Tengyur/Kangyur, Tōhoku D2224, digital edition by Esukhia and Barom Theksum Choling (github.com/Esukhia/derge-tengyur), file 051_རྒྱུད་འགྲེལ།_ཝི.txt — Tibetan translation, Wylie by the preparer

paraphrase: What is saṃsāra is certainly nirvāṇa; do not think of any difference; by the one nature difference is abandoned; I have fully realized the stainless.
translation_basis: Tibetan translation (the Apabhraṃśa/Sanskrit original not consulted); paraphrase made by the unit from the Tibetan

original.text: 'khor ba gang yin mya ngan 'das pa gang / / yid kyi dri ma dag la lhan cig skyes pa ste/ / de tshe mi mthun phyogs kyis 'jug pa med/ / ji ltar rgya mtsho dang bar gyur pa la/ / chu bur chu nyid yin te de nyid thim par 'gyur/ / nags dang khyim na byang chub gnas pa med/ /
original.edition: Derge Tengyur/Kangyur, Tōhoku D2224, digital edition by Esukhia and Barom Theksum Choling (github.com/Esukhia/derge-tengyur), file 051_རྒྱུད་འགྲེལ།_ཝི.txt — Tibetan translation, Wylie by the preparer
original.licence: Public domain (Derge xylograph; Esukhia/Barom digital edition, per the repository)

paraphrase: Saṃsāra or nirvāṇa — the innate lies in the purification of mind's stains; then the adverse side has no entry; as bubbles on a clear ocean are water and dissolve into it; awakening does not dwell in forest or house.
translation_basis: Tibetan translation (the Apabhraṃśa/Sanskrit original not consulted); paraphrase made by the unit from the Tibetan

original.text: lhan cig skyes bral gzhan gang gis/ / mya ngan 'das gang sgom byed pa/ / de dag 'gas kyang don dam ni/ / cig shos 'grub par mi 'gyur ro/ / gang zhig gang la mos par gyur pa des/ /
original.edition: Derge Tengyur/Kangyur, Tōhoku D2224, digital edition by Esukhia and Barom Theksum Choling (github.com/Esukhia/derge-tengyur), file 051_རྒྱུད་འགྲེལ།_ཝི.txt — Tibetan translation, Wylie by the preparer
original.licence: Public domain (Derge xylograph; Esukhia/Barom digital edition, per the repository)

paraphrase: Whoever meditates on nirvāṇa apart from the innate will not accomplish the ultimate; whatever one is devoted to, can one gain liberation by dwelling in meditative absorption?
translation_basis: Tibetan translation (the Apabhraṃśa/Sanskrit original not consulted); paraphrase made by the unit from the Tibetan

original.text: gnyis med sems kyi sdong po dam pa ni/ / khams gsum ma lus kun du khyab par song / / snying rje'i me tog gzhan phan 'bras bu 'dzin/ / ming ni mchog tu gzhan la phan pa'o/ / stong pa'i sdong po dam pa me tog rgyas/ / snying rje dam pa sna tshogs du mar ldan/ / lhun gyis grub pa phyi ma'i 'bras bu ste/ / bde ba 'di ni gzhan pa'i sems min no/ / stong pa'i sdong po dam pa'i snying rje min/ / gang la slar yang rtsa ba me tog lo 'dab med/ / de la dmigs par byed pa gang yin pa/ / der lhung bas ni yan lag med par 'gyur/ /
original.edition: Derge Tengyur/Kangyur, Tōhoku D2224, digital edition by Esukhia and Barom Theksum Choling (github.com/Esukhia/derge-tengyur), file 051_རྒྱུད་འགྲེལ།_ཝི.txt — Tibetan translation, Wylie by the preparer
original.licence: Public domain (Derge xylograph; Esukhia/Barom digital edition, per the repository)

paraphrase: The supreme tree of non-dual mind spreads through all three realms; it holds the flower of compassion and the fruit of benefit for others, its name is supreme benefit for others; the holy tree of emptiness blooms with the many flowers of compassion and its later fruit is spontaneous; but (if) the holy tree of emptiness is without compassion, with no root, flower or leaf, whoever takes it as object falls and is left without limbs.
translation_basis: Tibetan translation (the Apabhraṃśa/Sanskrit original not consulted); paraphrase made by the unit from the Tibetan
notes: v132–133 are compressed; the unit reads the negation as applying to emptiness without compassion.

original.text: gang zhig 'dod pa can gyi skye bo 'ongs pa'i tshe/ / de ni re ba med na gal te 'gro ba ni/ / phyi sgor bor ba'i kham phor blangs nas su/ / de bas khyim thab bor nas bsdad pa rung / / gzhan la phan pa'i don ni mi byed pa/ / 'dod pa po la sbyin pa mi ster ba/ / 'di ni 'khor ba'i 'bras bu gang yin lo/ / de bas bdag nyid bor bar byas na rung / /
original.edition: Derge Tengyur/Kangyur, Tōhoku D2224, digital edition by Esukhia and Barom Theksum Choling (github.com/Esukhia/derge-tengyur), file 051_རྒྱུད་འགྲེལ།_ཝི.txt — Tibetan translation, Wylie by the preparer
original.licence: Public domain (Derge xylograph; Esukhia/Barom digital edition, per the repository)

paraphrase: When a beggar with wants comes and goes away with nothing, better to have left the household; not working for others' benefit and not giving to one who asks — that is the fruit of saṃsāra; better to abandon oneself.
translation_basis: Tibetan translation (the Apabhraṃśa/Sanskrit original not consulted); paraphrase made by the unit from the Tibetan

original.text: bsam gtan gnas pas thar pa thob bam ci/ / mar me ci dgos lha bshos de ci dgos/ / de la ci bya gsang sngags bstan pa ci zhig dgos/ / 'bab stegs 'gro dang dka' thub mi dgos te/ / chu la zhugs pas thar pa thob bam ci/ /
original.edition: Derge Tengyur/Kangyur, Tōhoku D2224, digital edition by Esukhia and Barom Theksum Choling (github.com/Esukhia/derge-tengyur), file 051_རྒྱུད་འགྲེལ།_ཝི.txt — Tibetan translation, Wylie by the preparer
original.licence: Public domain (Derge xylograph; Esukhia/Barom digital edition, per the repository)

paraphrase: What need of lamps, of food offerings, of secret-mantra teaching? No need to go to bathing places or to practise austerities: is liberation gained by entering water?
translation_basis: Tibetan translation (the Apabhraṃśa/Sanskrit original not consulted); paraphrase made by the unit from the Tibetan

original.text: snying rje dang bral stong pa nyid zhugs gang / / des ni lam mchog rnyed pa ma yin no/ / 'on te snying rje 'ba' zhig bsgoms na yang / / 'khor ba 'dir gnas thar pa thob mi 'gyur/ / gang yang gnyis po sbyor bar nus pa des/ / 'khor bar mi gnas mya ngan 'das mi gnas/ /
original.edition: Derge Tengyur/Kangyur, Tōhoku D2224, digital edition by Esukhia and Barom Theksum Choling (github.com/Esukhia/derge-tengyur), file 051_རྒྱུད་འགྲེལ།_ཝི.txt — Tibetan translation, Wylie by the preparer
original.licence: Public domain (Derge xylograph; Esukhia/Barom digital edition, per the repository)

paraphrase: Whoever enters emptiness devoid of compassion does not find the supreme path; yet if one meditates on compassion alone, one stays in saṃsāra and does not gain liberation; whoever can join the two abides neither in saṃsāra nor in nirvāṇa.
translation_basis: Tibetan translation (the Apabhraṃśa/Sanskrit original not consulted); paraphrase made by the unit from the Tibetan

original.text: kye lags gang smras rdzun zhing log pa de bor la/ / gang la zhen pa yod pa de yang thong / / rtogs par gyur na thams cad de yin te/ / de la gzhan pa sus kyang shes mi 'gyur/ / klog pa de yin 'dzin dang sgom pa de yin te/ / bstan bcos snying la 'chad pa'ang de yin no/ / de mi mtshon pa'i lta ba yod min te/ / 'on kyang gcig pu bla ma'i zhal la ltos pa yin/ /
original.edition: Derge Tengyur/Kangyur, Tōhoku D2224, digital edition by Esukhia and Barom Theksum Choling (github.com/Esukhia/derge-tengyur), file 051_རྒྱུད་འགྲེལ།_ཝི.txt — Tibetan translation, Wylie by the preparer
original.licence: Public domain (Derge xylograph; Esukhia/Barom digital edition, per the repository)

paraphrase: Kye! Give up what is false and let go of whatever you cling to; when realized, all is that and nobody else knows it; it is reading, holding, meditating and explaining the treatises in one's heart; there is no view that does not point to it, yet one looks solely to the guru's mouth.
translation_basis: Tibetan translation (the Apabhraṃśa/Sanskrit original not consulted); paraphrase made by the unit from the Tibetan

original.text: bla ma'i smras pa gang gi snying zhugs pa/ / lag pa'i mthil du gnas pa'i gter mthong 'dra/ / gnyug ma'i rang bzhin byis pas ma mthong bar/ /
original.edition: Derge Tengyur/Kangyur, Tōhoku D2224, digital edition by Esukhia and Barom Theksum Choling (github.com/Esukhia/derge-tengyur), file 051_རྒྱུད་འགྲེལ།_ཝི.txt — Tibetan translation, Wylie by the preparer
original.licence: Public domain (Derge xylograph; Esukhia/Barom digital edition, per the repository)

paraphrase: Whoever takes the guru's words to heart sees (the innate) like a treasure in the palm of the hand; the childish do not see the innate nature and Saraha says they are deceived by error.
translation_basis: Tibetan translation (the Apabhraṃśa/Sanskrit original not consulted); paraphrase made by the unit from the Tibetan

original.text: de nyid mi shes bram ze ni/ / gyi na rigs byed gzhi dag 'don/ / sa chu ku sha dag byed dang / / khyim na gnas shing me la bsreg / don med sbyin sreg byed pa ni/ / du bas mig la gnod par bas/ /
original.edition: Derge Tengyur/Kangyur, Tōhoku D2224, digital edition by Esukhia and Barom Theksum Choling (github.com/Esukhia/derge-tengyur), file 051_རྒྱུད་འགྲེལ།_ཝི.txt — Tibetan translation, Wylie by the preparer
original.licence: Public domain (Derge xylograph; Esukhia/Barom digital edition, per the repository)

paraphrase: Brahmins who do not know reality recite the Vedas, purify with earth, water and kuśa grass, live at home and offer into the fire; their pointless fire offerings only hurt their eyes with smoke.
translation_basis: Tibetan translation (the Apabhraṃśa/Sanskrit original not consulted); paraphrase made by the unit from the Tibetan
notes: The polemic continues through v3 with staff-bearing ascetics.

original.text: gal te mngon du gyur na bsam gtan ci/ / gal te lkog tu gyur na mun pa 'jal/ / lhan cig skyes pa'i rang bzhin de nyid ni/ / dngos dang dngos po med pa ma yin te/ /
original.edition: Derge Tengyur/Kangyur, Tōhoku D2224, digital edition by Esukhia and Barom Theksum Choling (github.com/Esukhia/derge-tengyur), file 051_རྒྱུད་འགྲེལ།_ཝི.txt — Tibetan translation, Wylie by the preparer
original.licence: Public domain (Derge xylograph; Esukhia/Barom digital edition, per the repository)

paraphrase: If it were manifest, what need of meditation? If hidden, one is measuring darkness. The nature of the innate is neither a thing nor the absence of things.
translation_basis: Tibetan translation (the Apabhraṃśa/Sanskrit original not consulted); paraphrase made by the unit from the Tibetan

original.text: srid pa'i phyag rgyas 'gro ba ma lus bslus/ / rang bzhin gnyug ma sus kyang blangs pa med/ / rgyud med sngags med bsam bya bsam gtan med/ / de kun rang yid 'khrul bar byed pa'i rgyu/ /
original.edition: Derge Tengyur/Kangyur, Tōhoku D2224, digital edition by Esukhia and Barom Theksum Choling (github.com/Esukhia/derge-tengyur), file 051_རྒྱུད་འགྲེལ།_ཝི.txt — Tibetan translation, Wylie by the preparer
original.licence: Public domain (Derge xylograph; Esukhia/Barom digital edition, per the repository)

paraphrase: All beings are deceived by the seal of existence; no one has grasped the natural state; no tantra, no mantra, nothing to contemplate, no meditation — all these are causes that make one's own mind err.
translation_basis: Tibetan translation (the Apabhraṃśa/Sanskrit original not consulted); paraphrase made by the unit from the Tibetan

original.text: rang bzhin dag pa'i sems la bsam gtan dag gis mi bslad de/ / bdag gi de nyid bde la gnas shing gdung bar ma byed cig / za zhing 'thung la gnyid sprod kyis dga' zhing / / rtag tu yang dang yang du 'khor lo 'gengs/ /
original.edition: Derge Tengyur/Kangyur, Tōhoku D2224, digital edition by Esukhia and Barom Theksum Choling (github.com/Esukhia/derge-tengyur), file 051_རྒྱུད་འགྲེལ།_ཝི.txt — Tibetan translation, Wylie by the preparer
original.licence: Public domain (Derge xylograph; Esukhia/Barom digital edition, per the repository)

paraphrase: Do not spoil the naturally pure mind with meditations; abide in the bliss of your own reality and do not torment yourself; eating, drinking and delighting, continually fill the circle again and again.
translation_basis: Tibetan translation (the Apabhraṃśa/Sanskrit original not consulted); paraphrase made by the unit from the Tibetan
notes: 'Filling the circle' ('khor lo 'gengs) may refer to the tantric feast (gaṇacakra); unit's reading.

original.text: gang du rlung dang sems ni mi rgyu zhing / / nyi ma zla ba 'jug pa med gyur pa/ / mi shes pa dag gnas de dbugs phyung cig / mda' bsnun gyis ni man ngag thams cad bstan nas song / / gnyis su mi bya gcig tu bya ba ste/ / rigs la bye brag dag tu ma 'byed par/ /
original.edition: Derge Tengyur/Kangyur, Tōhoku D2224, digital edition by Esukhia and Barom Theksum Choling (github.com/Esukhia/derge-tengyur), file 051_རྒྱུད་འགྲེལ།_ཝི.txt — Tibetan translation, Wylie by the preparer
original.licence: Public domain (Derge xylograph; Esukhia/Barom digital edition, per the repository)

paraphrase: Where wind and mind do not move and sun and moon do not enter, there, ignorant ones, take rest; Saraha has taught all the instructions and gone. Do not make two, make one; do not distinguish between castes.
translation_basis: Tibetan translation (the Apabhraṃśa/Sanskrit original not consulted); paraphrase made by the unit from the Tibetan
notes: 'Sun and moon' = the right and left channels in the commentarial reading (unit's note).

original.text: khams gsum ma lus 'di dag thams cad ni/ / 'dod chags chen po gcig tu kha dog sgyur cig dang / / der ni thog ma dbus mtha' med/ / ji srid mya ngan 'das pa min/ / bde ba chen po mchog 'di la/ / bdag dang gzhan du yod ma yin/ / mdun dang rgyab dang phyogs bcu ru/ / gang gang mthong ba de de nyid/ /
original.edition: Derge Tengyur/Kangyur, Tōhoku D2224, digital edition by Esukhia and Barom Theksum Choling (github.com/Esukhia/derge-tengyur), file 051_རྒྱུད་འགྲེལ།_ཝི.txt — Tibetan translation, Wylie by the preparer
original.licence: Public domain (Derge xylograph; Esukhia/Barom digital edition, per the repository)

paraphrase: Turn the whole of the three realms into the one colour of great passion; there is no beginning, middle or end; in this supreme great bliss there is no self and other; whatever is seen in front, behind and in the ten directions is that itself.
translation_basis: Tibetan translation (the Apabhraṃśa/Sanskrit original not consulted); paraphrase made by the unit from the Tibetan

original.text: kye ho 'di ni rang rig yin pa ste/ / 'di la 'khrul pa ma byed cig / dngos dang dngos med bde bar gshegs pa'i 'ching ba ste/ / srid dang mnyam nyid tha dad ma 'byed par/ / gnyug ma'i yid ni gcig tu gtod dang rnal 'byor pa/ / chu la chu bzhag bzhin du shes par byos/ /
original.edition: Derge Tengyur/Kangyur, Tōhoku D2224, digital edition by Esukhia and Barom Theksum Choling (github.com/Esukhia/derge-tengyur), file 051_རྒྱུད་འགྲེལ།_ཝི.txt — Tibetan translation, Wylie by the preparer
original.licence: Public domain (Derge xylograph; Esukhia/Barom digital edition, per the repository)

paraphrase: Kye ho! This is self-awareness; do not err here; thing and no-thing are the bondage of the sugatas; do not separate existence from equality; yogin, fix the innate mind one-pointedly and know it as water placed in water.
translation_basis: Tibetan translation (the Apabhraṃśa/Sanskrit original not consulted); paraphrase made by the unit from the Tibetan

original.text: bla ma dam pa'i bka' yis bde bar yid ches par/ / nga yis brjod du yod min zhes ni mda' bsnun smra/ / gdod nas dag pa nam mkha'i rang bzhin la/ / bltas shing bltas shing mthong ba 'gag par 'gyur/ / de lta bu nyid dus su 'gog par 'gyur/ /
original.edition: Derge Tengyur/Kangyur, Tōhoku D2224, digital edition by Esukhia and Barom Theksum Choling (github.com/Esukhia/derge-tengyur), file 051_རྒྱུད་འགྲེལ།_ཝི.txt — Tibetan translation, Wylie by the preparer
original.licence: Public domain (Derge xylograph; Esukhia/Barom digital edition, per the repository)

paraphrase: Trusting in the true guru's word, (knowing that) it cannot be spoken, Saraha says: looking and looking at the primordially pure sky-like nature, seeing ceases; so, in time, it is stopped.
translation_basis: Tibetan translation (the Apabhraṃśa/Sanskrit original not consulted); paraphrase made by the unit from the Tibetan

original.text: gnyug ma'i rang bzhin sus kyang mtshon du med/ / sems kyi rtsa ba min mtshon te/ / lhan cig skyes pa rnam gsum gyi/ / gang las de skyes gang du nub/ / gang du gnas 'gyur gsal bar mi shes so/ / rtsa ba bral ba'i de nyid gang sems pa/ / bla ma'i man ngag mthong ba de yis chog /
original.edition: Derge Tengyur/Kangyur, Tōhoku D2224, digital edition by Esukhia and Barom Theksum Choling (github.com/Esukhia/derge-tengyur), file 051_རྒྱུད་འགྲེལ།_ཝི.txt — Tibetan translation, Wylie by the preparer
original.licence: Public domain (Derge xylograph; Esukhia/Barom digital edition, per the repository)

paraphrase: The whole world is deluded by meditation; no one can point out the innate nature; the root of mind is not pointed to; it is not clearly known from where the threefold innate arises, where it sets or where it abides; for whoever thinks of that rootless reality, the guru's instruction he has seen is enough.
translation_basis: Tibetan translation (the Apabhraṃśa/Sanskrit original not consulted); paraphrase made by the unit from the Tibetan
notes: 'Threefold innate' (lhan cig skyes pa rnam gsum) is not explained in the verse.

original.text: khro ba'i rang bzhin sems kyi ngo bo nyid yin zhes/ / rmongs rnams mda' bsnun gyis smras tse ne shes par byos/ / gnyug ma'i rang bzhin tshig gis mi brjod kyang / / slob dpon man ngag mig gis mthong bar 'gyur/ /
original.edition: Derge Tengyur/Kangyur, Tōhoku D2224, digital edition by Esukhia and Barom Theksum Choling (github.com/Esukhia/derge-tengyur), file 051_རྒྱུད་འགྲེལ།_ཝི.txt — Tibetan translation, Wylie by the preparer
original.licence: Public domain (Derge xylograph; Esukhia/Barom digital edition, per the repository)

paraphrase: Saraha tells the deluded to know that the nature of anger is the very nature of mind; though the natural state is not expressed in words, it will be seen with the eye of the master's instruction.
translation_basis: Tibetan translation (the Apabhraṃśa/Sanskrit original not consulted); paraphrase made by the unit from the Tibetan
